name: Customization.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Saga Telecom supports OEM services regarding management features and manufacturing.
Management Software
Show customer’s logo/model on the management interface
Change IP address
MAC address
SNMP, OID
Above changes are free of cost, see below an example of COMMON practices.
Please know that
Discussion is required for complex changes, meanwhile an NDA(Non-disclosure Agreement) contract will be agreed upon and signed to protect your benefits
Font format&GUI color are NOT changeable for the management interface.
Manufacturing
This is mainly about PVC mask and involves cost.
For other small changes like power terminal block, mounting kit, panels..., it is USUALLY NOT required, our models enjoy an expert design.
PVC mask
MoQ: 300pcs, unit price: 1usd/pc
Examples are:
An order less than 300pcs, lets say 50pcs
50pcs will be consumed and 250pcs are left at the moment(Either ship them together with the purchased items or keep them in our warehouse for next orders)
An order over 300pcs, lets say 350pcs
Then we could order an exact amount 350pcs for this order.
There will be none left.
We usually provide neutral devices for testing purpose.
It is better to discuss PVC mask customization when testing proves fine.
For some manufacturing changes like packing box, user manual...
It is supported and discussion is required.
